jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (PHP)
jobs.description:
Most QA work is keeping a stable system stable. This is different. You'll hold quality high on a large-scale marketplace that's being rebuilt and migrated while it runs.
There's a live migration from GCP to AWS and a full version 2 build underway.
This is an initial 3 to 6 month contract, starting as soon as possible.
You'll embed into one of our product squads as its quality engineer, alongside a tech lead, a principal engineer, three full-stack engineers and a platform engineer. You'll be the squad's quality lead, owning test coverage, automation and validation standards for everything it ships.
Day to day, you'll write and maintain automated tests, shape the squad's test approach, help manage releases and improve how we deploy.
This is a capacity role alongside an established permanent team, so you'll need to be productive quickly without a long ramp.
The platform
This is a large-scale marketplace. Very few platforms handle a product catalogue or transaction volume at this level.
It runs on PHP and Laravel today, moving towards a service-based architecture in TypeScript and Node, so you'll be testing across both as the stack shifts.
The roadmap includes agentic AI workflows built into the platform, retail media integrated directly into the marketplace, and infrastructure work targeting cost and performance at high volume. Much of this is being attempted at volumes rarely tested in a marketplace before, so the work leans research-led rather than routine.
Who This Suits
A fast-paced environment where the ground shifts. You'll do well if you're comfortable with ambiguity and can hold a standard while things move around you.
Location and basis
Contractors engage on a B2B basis.
Fully flexible working: home, office, or a mix, your call. We just ask that you're based within one of these areas:
Bulgaria: within 80km of Sofia
Romania: within 80km of Cluj, Bucharest or Iasi
Applications from outside these areas won't be considered.
What We Need
The essentials:
5+ years in manual and automated testing, senior enough to set standards and deliver without close oversight
Solid PHP, plus one other language (TypeScript, Java, C# or Python)
Confident across manual and automated testing, and can build, maintain and extend test frameworks
Hands-on experience with Cypress
Can own releases end to end: planning, coordinating, shipping to production
Track record of improving deployment processes
Strong grasp of SDLC QA: planning, test cases, bug tracking, reporting
Hands-on with a test case management system such as TestRail
Comfortable working in English, written and spoken
Also Needed
Working understanding of OOP principles and design patterns
Good knowledge of CI/CD systems
Experience with test reporting tools and services
Nice To Have
Playwright with TypeScript used professionally
Hands-on with AWS
GenAI tools already part of your day-to-day QA workflow
Ready to apply?
Submit your application below.

jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Python, STC & Networking)
jobs.description:
Project description - VR-125264
Project Description: Product verification & testing for an L1-L3 Traffic Generator Solution for a Global Networking Testing and Validation equipment provider.
Our team: A team of networking enthusiasts willing to contribute to customer success.
Technologies used: Networking protocols, traffic generation tools, Windows/Linux servers, network virtualization, network management tools, microservices.
Opportunities: Networking and testing certifications, collaboration with an international team of professionals, working with the latest networking technologies and concepts, access to training.
Responsibilities
Design, implement and maintain long-running automated test scenarios (soak tests spanning days/weeks) using Spirent TestCenter APIs, covering performance, scalability, convergence, and protocol stability under sustained traffic load.
Derive automation requirements from manual functional test specifications and hardware validation reports
Collaborate with development team to translate software requirements into high-quality test automation suites
Develop automation for the end-to-end solution validation and integrate the automation for seamless validation.
Implement, execute and debug Python automated test scripts on Linux-based platforms
Analyze and manage automated regression test execution failures
Debug and troubleshoot complex issues and work closely with the engineering team on the failures and validate the fixes
Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines
Collaborate closely with hardware and software development teams to triage test failures and drive quality improvements
Reproduce and root-cause hardware/firmware defects through systematic test isolation
Make use of AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, agentic AI) given customer-specific heavy usage patterns.
Review customer deployments and customer-found issues and address any gaps in the test coverage.
Skills
o Overall QA background of 6+ years, with 4+ years in testing networking domain-related applications.
o QA Automation experience in an Agile/SCRUM team, focused on API and/or CLI testing (4+ years);
Python strongly preferred (other comparable languages considered).
o Automated Testing for API or CLI 4+ years, including experience in test harness or framework
development.
o Hands-on experience automating Spirent TestCenter (STC) using its Python API — specifically StcPython
native API, the REST-based stcrestclient library (py-stcrestclient), or HLTAPI (High Level Test API); ability
to script traffic port configuration, device emulation, traffic stream setup, result subscription and statistics
retrieval.
o Familiarity with STC Lab Server architecture: connecting to chassis, managing test sessions, and
executing automated sequences without GUI dependency.
o Experience writing and maintaining long-running automation suites (soak tests of days/weeks duration)
with robust result collection, error handling, and reporting.
o Working knowledge of L2/L3 protocols exercised through STC: Ethernet, VLAN/QinQ, BGP (v4/v6),
OSPF (v2/v3), IS-IS, MPLS/LDP, BFD, and data-center protocols such as VXLAN and EVPN; ability to
configure emulated/simulated router topologies for scale and convergence testing.
o Familiarity with RFC 2544 / RFC 2889 benchmarking methodology for throughput, latency, frame loss and
back-to-back testing.
o Practical experience with AI tooling in day-to-day activities to improve productivity and delivery quality
(code generation, code review, automation, agentic AI, MCP usage, etc.).
o Experience in performance, scale, and convergence testing; ability to analyze and improve performance
and convergence at system level.
o Ability to develop and publish solution validation documents and test reports.
o Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate effectively across QA and
Development teams.
o Highly motivated, self-driven, and able to collaborate cross-functionally to meet challenging goals.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description:
JOIN OUR QA ENGINEERING TEAM
At Levi Nine we are passionate about what we do. We love our work and together in a team we are smarter and stronger. We work in a dynamic and challenging environment with talented and forward-thinking people who are part of creative and innovative teams. We are looking for skilled team players who make change happen. Are you one of these players?
PROJECT DESCRIPTION:
Our customer is a world-leading provider of transport solutions, driving the shift towards a sustainable transport system and creating a world of mobility that is better for business, society, and the environment. The product-related services we work on help end customers streamline their transport operations. You will join a collaborative, customer-focused environment and contribute to the quality of digital services used to process and present vehicle-related data.
THE ROLE INVOLVES:
Own the testing approach for new vehicle signals and related data flows, from test analysis and planning through execution and reporting.
Design, execute, and maintain technical test scenarios covering data quality, data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and edge cases.
Validate how vehicle signals are ingested, processed, stored, and presented in reports and applications.
Support the quality assurance of the reports, with a focus on vehicle emissions data and associated business rules.
Investigate data quality issues using analytical techniques, queries, logs, and monitoring information, and work with developers to identify root causes.
Perform manual and automated testing across relevant services, APIs, and data layers.
Test applications running in cloud environments and support quality checks across development, test, and production-like environments.
Collaborate closely with developers, product stakeholders, and other QA specialists to define acceptance criteria, risks, and appropriate test coverage.
Communicate test results, defects, and quality risks clearly, and take ownership of follow-up until resolution.
TECHNICAL PLAYGROUND:
5+ years of hands-on experience in a QA Engineer, Test Engineer, or similar technical testing role.
Hands-on experience with different types of Testing.
Experience defining test strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, and traceable test evidence.
Strong experience testing backend services, APIs, integrations, or data-intensive applications.
Practical experience validating data quality, including completeness, accuracy, consistency, and exception scenarios (checking data coming from streams and APIs).
Hands-on experience retrieving and analyzing data from databases (preferably non-SQL).
Hands-on experience with test automation (frontend and backend), with the ability to extend existing automation frameworks and/or establish new frameworks from the ground up.
Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Java, TypeScript.
Working knowledge of AWS and experience testing cloud-hosted applications, including investigating logs, querying databases, monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, DynamoDB).
Understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures.
Experience handling customer support cases.
A deliberate and pragmatic approach to using AI tools. Ability to provide effective context, guide AI through large or unfamiliar codebases, and critically evaluate the quality and reliability of AI-generated output.
NICE TO HAVE:
Experience in automotive, connected vehicles, telematics, or mobility-related products.
Exposure to streaming technology or other high-volume time-series data.
Cloud certification or relevant training in data testing or data quality engineering.
Awareness of DevOps and Agile principles and a shift-left approach to quality.
Relevant university degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data, or a related field.
SOFT SKILLS:
Fluent English, with good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong engineering instinct (do the right thing), a deep understanding of computer science.
Strong interpersonal and assertive communication skills, great team member.
Flexible and adaptive working attitude - self-motivated and taking ownership.
Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Desire to continuously learn and improve in a complex, rapidly evolving environment.
WHAT WE HOPE YOU MIGHT ENJOY:
Great colleagues, a tech and fun oriented place to work
Personal and technical development through courses, training, conferences, and certifications under Levi9 Academy umbrella
Udemy for business
A delightful book with Bookster
Parenting sessions if needed
Team buildings (with the company, your project team, or your department)
Fun activities with colleagues sharing your passion (Ex: CSR campaigns, Movie Nights, Football, etc.)
21 annual vacation days + 1 extra day every two years
Floating holidays
Vacation Bonus
Meal tickets
Medical subscription
Hybrid way of working
Unlimited access to Levi9 gym
